result.stdout:
Usage: lyric [command] [args]

  Run `lyric` with no command inside a project to build it.

Project:
  lyric init    [<dir>] [--name <Name>] [--lib] [--force]
                (scaffold a new app (or --lib library) package: lyric.toml + src + .gitignore)
  lyric build   [<source.l>] [-o <output>] [--force] [--manifest <lyric.toml>] [--target dotnet|jvm] [--no-restore] [--watch]
                (no source: builds the discovered project's [project.packages] into one DLL;
                 auto-restores deps when lyric.lock is missing or stale unless --no-restore)
  lyric build   --release [<source.l>] [--manifest <lyric.toml>] [--rid <rid>] [-o <bin>]
                (self-contained Native AOT binary; no source: builds the discovered project)
  lyric check   [<source.l>...] [--manifest <lyric.toml>] [--target dotnet|jvm]
                (type-check without producing a usable output artifact)
  lyric clean   [<dir>] [--manifest <lyric.toml>]
                (remove bin/, .lyric-run/, .lyric-test/, .lyric-bench/, .lyric-check/, .lyric-release/)
  lyric restore [--manifest <lyric.toml>] [--locked]
  lyric update  [--manifest <lyric.toml>]
                (re-resolve all deps to latest compatible versions and rewrite lyric.lock)
  lyric deps    [--manifest <lyric.toml>]
                (print the resolved dependency tree from lyric.lock)
  lyric add     <name>[@<version>] [--path <dir>] [--git <url> [--tag|--rev|--branch <ref>]]
                [--nuget] [--manifest <lyric.toml>] [--no-restore]
                (adds/updates a dependency in [dependencies] (or [nuget]) and restores)
  lyric remove  <name> [--nuget] [--manifest <lyric.toml>] [--no-restore]
                (removes a dependency from [dependencies] (or [nuget]) and restores)
  lyric publish [--manifest <lyric.toml>] [--dll <path>] [-o <dir>] [--registry <url>] [--api-key <key>]
  lyric search  <term>
  lyric version [--manifest <lyric.toml>]
                (print the current package version)
  lyric version --set <semver> [--manifest <lyric.toml>]
